title: dotbabel task state
description: The contract and durable state of one piece of work without a spec, written by `dotbabel task` to <git-dir>/dotbabel/tasks/<slug>.json (never the working tree, so it cannot appear in git status). The goal and a non-empty done_when list are fixed before execution; phase, decisions, pending items, and dependencies are written as the work proceeds. Per worktree: it survives context resets, crashes, and new sessions there, and does not travel to another machine. This is schema version 2; the reader also accepts a version-1 file, which has no depends_on, and reads it as version 2 with none.

slug.description: The file name without .json: lowercase letters, digits, and dashes.

status.description: Only open tasks are printed at session start. A closed task keeps its record.

done_when.description: The checks that decide the work is done, defined before execution starts.

phase.description: Where the work stands, in the vocabulary of the skill that drives it.

decisions.description: Append-only: each decision with the time it was recorded.

depends_on.description: The references this task waits on: a task of this clone (<slug>), a task of another clone on this machine (github.com/owner/repo:<slug>), or a pull request or issue (owner/repo#123). Slugs are unique per clone.

branch.description: The branch checked out when the task was created; null on a detached HEAD.

worktree.description: The worktree root the task was created in.
